content:
The Cosmic Orange iPhone 17 Pro has been my favorite color variation in years. I love how the color just pops. I even recently wrote about my Cosmic Orange-themed everyday carry. The Cosmic Orange color-matching continues with Nomad’s limited-edition Stellar Orange Stand One charger. This charger is awesome for so many reasons, but it all starts with the design and materials they chose to make a premium, well-built product that just happens to perfectly match my iPhone. Here is what you need to know!

Nomad’s Stand One has been known as an industry leader in MagSafe charging stands. It’s extremely well-built, has insanely strong magnets, uses high-quality materials like metal and glass, has some great heft, and supports the fastest 25W wireless charging for the iPhone. You get:

  • Color-matched to Apple’s Cosmic Orange iPhone 17 Pro
  • Up to 25W wireless charging for Qi2 and MagSafe devices
  • Supports iPhone StandBy mode
  • Dedicated wireless charging spot for AirPods
  • Premium metal and glass construction
  • Weighted 575g design for stability
  • Anti-slip rubber base
  • Includes 2-meter USB-C to USB-C braided cable
  • Compatible with MagSafe and Qi2-certified devices

Aside from build quality and charging speed, one standout design element is the weighted metal chassis. It weighs a bit over a pound, and that is for a reason. Most lightweight MagSafe chargers have the problem that the magnets are too strong for the charger’s weight. So when you go to pull your iPhone off the charger, the charger either comes with it, or you have to use two hands to remove it. With the Stand One, this does not happen. That adds to the premium feel of it all. I compare it to the simple one-handed opening of a MacBook vs. the two-handed prying of a Windows laptop.

My thoughts

I have always been a fan of Nomad’s hardware because they focus on permoum materials and thoughtful design rather then just checking off feature boxes. The Stand One has already been one of my favorite MafSafe charging stands, but the fact that it now matches the iPhone 17 Pro’s color takes it to another level for me.

Again, this charger supports the full 25W MagSafe charging for supported iPhones. It is also at the perfect angle. Nomad chose a 21-degree angle, noting that it is one of the more comfortable viewing angles for most people in most situations. The Stand One also works exceptionally well with Standby Mode. I like being able to quickly glance at it for some of my calendar, time, and weather information without being drawn to open up the phone.

The AirPods slot is also a nice touch. Being able to wirelessly charge your AirPods Pro confidently is great. I cannot tell you the number of times I’ve placed my AirPods on a charging pad that is misaligned, and they end up not charging. The Stand One has a bit of a divot to ensure the AirPods line up correctly every time.

One thing to note here is that this does not come with a charging brick. They recommend 40W or higher to ensure you get full charging functionality. They also offer a small 20% discount if you want to bundle a Nomad charging brick with this.

Pricing and availability

The limited-edition Nomad Stand One in Stellar Orange is available today direct from Nomad for $135. They still sell their black-and-white versions for $125 as well. So if you are looking for a premium MagSafe charger that matches your Cosmic Orange iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max, this is the way to go.
